legend: Geo Ghaffar has become the boss and he didn't want to tell Da7doo7 "You're FIRED" so he told him "solve this problem or you're FIRED", knowing that Da7doo7 is bad at geometry. Of course Da7doo7 called you, his best friend, for help.

You are given $$$n$$$ distinct points in a $$$2D$$$ plane with integer coordinates. You will draw a finite circle in such a way it passes through the maximum number of points. Since you hate floating numbers, you only have to print this maximum number.
input: The first line of the input contains a single integer $$$T$$$ ($$$1 \le T \le 100$$$) representing the number of test cases.

For each test case, the first line contains a single integer $$$n$$$ ($$$2 \le n \le 200$$$) denoting the number of points. Each of the next $$$n$$$ lines contain two integers $$$x_i$$$ and $$$y_i$$$ ($$$-10^6 \le x_i, y_i \le 10^6$$$) — the coordinates of every point. It is guaranteed that the given points are distinct.
It is guaranteed that the sum of $$$n$$$ over all test cases does not exceed $$$200$$$.
output: For each test case, print the answer in a single line.

legend: Geo Ghaffar 成了老板，他不想告诉 Da7doo7 "你被解雇了"，于是告诉他 "解决这个问题，否则你就被解雇了"，因为他知道 Da7doo7 不擅长几何。当然，Da7doo7 给他最好的朋友--你打电话寻求帮助。
在 $$$2D$$$ 平面上有 $$$n$$$ 个不同的点，它们的坐标都是整数。你要画一个有限圆，使它通过最大数量的点。由于您讨厌浮点数，因此只需打印最大值即可。
input: 输入的第一行包含一个整数 $$$T$$$ ($$$1 \le T \le 100$$$），代表测试用例的数量。
对于每个测试用例，第一行包含一个整数 $$$n$$$ ($$$2 \le n \le 200$$$），表示点的数量。接下来的每一行 $$$n$$$ 都包含两个整数 $$$x_i$$$ 和 $$$y_i$$$ ($$$-10^6 \le x_i, y_i \le 10^6$$$）--每个点的坐标。保证给定的点是不同的。
保证所有测试用例的 $$$n$$$ 之和不超过 $$$200$$$。
output: 对于每个测试用例，用一行打印答案。
